description: Elections Commission - Notice declaring Mr. A. M. Appuhami as a member of the Siyambalanduwa P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Siyambalanduwa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a newly elected member, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
